newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans down in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans down in slow trade.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans were lower in slow midsession trade Friday at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with little demand from crushers, traders said.

The FAS elevator soybean price in Rosario lost $3 to $290. Cash sunflower seed lost $2 in Buenos Aires to $224, and $4 in Rosario to $224, dragged down by lower soybean prices and lazy oil values. Sunflower turnover was slight. Cash maize was $1 higher in Quequen at $107. Maize volume was heavy, but prices seemed to have found a floor after recent big falls, traders said. Cash wheat lost $2 in Queuquen to $158 in slow trade.
